conventions: A topicalizing 'As for' the ASV writes for a clause-opening waw plus explicit pronoun (va'ani -> 'As for me') is the waw's connective under rule 14's open list, headed on 'as'; it is marked added under rule 16 only where the waw already holds a separately written 'And'. Corpus: 8 units in 6 chapters (2SA.9.11, EZK.1.10/13/18 ...).
report: Checked every cross-verse bucket. The suffix, preposition, divine-name, nefesh, asher, paneh and ga'avah differences are all ASV-driven (possessive vs object pronoun, vocative O vs bare name, of-presence vs face, etc.) and are not splits.

One real correction: PSA.31.22 va'ani amarti -> 'As for me, I said'. The verse pass left 'As for' added and the waw unrepresented; the corpus aligns a waw to 'As for' in 8 units across 6 chapters (2SA.9.11, EZK.1.10/13/18 ...), and rule 14 reads a waw's connective off the ASV with an open list. Rule 16's 'as for ... added' example is one where the waw already holds a written 'And'; here it holds nothing. Patched: waw -> 'As for' headed on 'as', 'ani' keeps 'me'. This also clears the BSB disagreement on that waw.

Requests resolved without change: Chief Musician (PSA.31.0) heads on Musician, matching the corpus majority 37:18; lakach 'take away' (PSA.31.13) keeps 'away' with the verb as in all 55 corpus units; mah 'Oh how' (PSA.31.19) keeps 'Oh' with the particle headed on 'how' as at PRO.30.13 and PSA.119.97.

Remaining BSB disagreements are convention: four lameds (two resultative lameds after hayah in 31.2 under rule 21, dative lameds silenced by recasting in 31.9 and 31.21 under rule 40) and the paragogic he of 31.16 under rule 32. None is an error.

Checked also: 31.1 al+le-olam fused into 'never' beside 31.17 al -> 'not' (both what the ASV wrote); 31.9 'yea' added before an asyndetic noun; 31.6/31.19 articled participles take 'them that' on the article while 31.15/31.19 anarthrous ones take it on the participle; 31.24 vocative 'ye' on the participle with 'that' on its article, as rule 36 directs. No promotion: the chapter taught nothing the contract and corpus do not already hold.
